senses.en: To obtain or come to possess something.
senses.example: She acquired fluent Japanese after living in Tokyo.

senses.en: To buy another company or its assets.
senses.example: The company acquired three smaller startups last quarter.

senses.en: A planned route or schedule for a journey.
senses.example: Please review the itinerary before our trip to Osaka.

senses.en: To discuss something in order to reach an agreement.
senses.example: We need to negotiate better terms with the supplier.

senses.en: To successfully get over or past a difficult obstacle.
senses.example: The driver carefully negotiated the narrow mountain road.

senses.en: A document requesting payment for goods or services.
senses.example: The invoice was sent to the accounting department yesterday.

senses.en: To change the time of a planned event.
senses.example: Can we reschedule tomorrow's meeting to next Monday?

senses.en: A written guarantee promising to repair or replace a product if needed.
senses.example: This laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
Thank you for your prompt response to our inquiry.

senses.en: To cause someone to do something.
senses.example: The poor sales prompted the board to change strategy.

senses.en: An instruction or cue that tells you what to do.
senses.example: Follow the on-screen prompt to complete the setup.

senses.en: The process of repairing and improving a building or space.
senses.example: The office renovation will be completed by next month.
